scope: Compact historical summaries from archived complete measurements; no raw signals, spectra, machine identities, absolute filesystem paths or uncompleted timing extrapolations. Source artifacts are identified by filename and SHA256; their large raw contents are not part of this summary.

main_matrix.timer_scope: A fresh complete joint PSD and NSD call, including original plan, working allocations, output construction and close. Input preparation/checks and whole-child time are separate.

native_pool_fresh_1b_pair.qualification: One ordered E-to-G pair; G was already faster before retirement. Full ratio is not an isolated causal retirement gain; initial peak is unchanged.

native_pool_100m_counterpair.qualification: Successful memory lifecycle change; opposite order reverses the timing preference, so no consistent 100M speedup is established.

smoothing_workers.qualification: Two timing pairs per case; five extra profile pairs are excluded from medians. The selected 30M repeat is separate. Narrow legacy supervisor PID lookup was unreliable; child self-measured RSS and existing hard cgroup limits remain separate.

prime_bluestein.qualification: Passed noise/DC cross-route equality; strict 3-ppm original gate fails some tone bins. All reported maxima remain below the user-approved 1%; exact per-pair evidence in original review. No universal platform default claim.
prime_bluestein.reassessment_policy: User-authorized <1% relative numerical differences plus negligible absolute differences; original failed 3-ppm/atol-zero evidence remains unchanged.

packed_real.reassessment: All saved values independently rechecked against the user-approved strict less-than-1% relative criterion; original evidence is unchanged. No performance claim.
packed_real.file_footprint: Original prototype retains 16N workspace bytes and 24N total large-file bytes.

ram_admission_model_1b.scope: Calculated admission estimates only, not measured RAM or timings; decimal GB, empirical 8N-byte FFTW planning reserve plus 256 MiB base reserve.

column_strategy_screen.timer_scope: Unchanged complete joint PSD+NSD disk call, including original Parseval diagnostics, progress checkpoints and workspace cleanup. Canonical input preparation and pre/post input checksums are outside this timer.

children.fine_phase_qualification: Nested phases overlap. Do not sum all phase values; execute_total_s and power_total_s are parent intervals.

column_strategy_screen.qualification: One ordered auto-to-strided pair with identical factors and numerical output. Cache/order effects are not controlled by a reverse pair. Process I/O counters include page-cache/writeback effects, and strided writes are much higher. Shared-cgroup counters are not attributed to the child. No universal default-policy or cross-platform speed claim.
